module: Small in-memory pixel drawing library (8-bit RGBA buffer via FFI): points, lines, circles, rectangles, icons and text in the 'mini_font' bitmap font (capitals, digits and a few signs). The buffer is saved as an image (GBitmap:saveFile). Loaded with require('utils/pixellib'); M.create() returns a LuaPixelBuffer object. Useful to generate debug images (maps, graphs) without UI. See M.test() for a complete example.
usage:
local pb = require('utils/pixellib').create()
pb:init(250, 250)
pb:fill(ColorI(255,255,255,255))
pb:drawLine(vec3(0,0,0), vec3(100,50,0), ColorI(255,0,0,255), 2)
pb:drawText(vec3(10,200,0), 'Hello', ColorI(0,0,0,255))
pb:saveFile('test.png')
notes: Drawing positions (pos, p1, pos1…) are vec3 of which only x and y are used (z ignored). Colors are tables/objects with integer fields r, g, b, a 0..255 (e.g. ColorI(255,0,0,255)).
Coordinates are in pixels; the origin (0,0) is at the top left; pixels outside the buffer are ignored (drawPixel); the buffer memory is indexed y*width + x.
drawText uppercases the text and only handles the mini_font characters (A-Z, 0-9, ! ? ' " . , : - _ and space); the position pos.y is the BOTTOM of the text line (the text goes up above it).
Inconsistency: getPixel does not apply math.floor to x and y (unlike drawPixel); with non-integer coordinates the FFI index can be wrong.
Inconsistency: LuaPixelBuffer:init allocates width*height without rounding (math.floor is only applied to the width/height fields), which can undersize the buffer with decimal dimensions.
drawText: for a space, x advances by 4 then, since the letter is not found in mini_font, there is no extra advance; the consumedWidth count only counts the drawn characters.
The M.test() functions write 'helloworld.png' in the current directory.

create.desc: Creates an empty LuaPixelBuffer object; then call :init(width, height) to allocate the buffer.

test.desc: Demonstration: draws several primitives and text in a 250x250 buffer then saves it as 'helloworld.png'.

LuaPixelBuffer.desc: RGBA pixel buffer returned by create(). Fields: width, height, bufSize, buf (cdata rgba_pixel_t[?]).

init.desc: Allocates the buffer and sets width/height (rounded down to the integer). Pixels initially zero (transparent black).

saveFile.desc: Saves the buffer as an image via an engine GBitmap (format depends on the extension, e.g. .png). Logs an error if loading into the bitmap fails.

_allocate_buffer.desc: Allocates the FFI array of n pixels. Called by init.

drawPixel.desc: Writes the color to a pixel (copies r, g, b, a, no alpha blending). Ignores coordinates outside the buffer.

getPixel.desc: Reads a pixel from the buffer.

returns.desc: rgba_pixel_t (fields r,g,b,a), nil if outside the buffer

drawPoint.desc: Draws a point: one pixel if size is 1/nil/0, otherwise a filled disc of approximate diameter size.

fill.desc: Fills the whole buffer with a color.

drawCircle.desc: Draws the outline of a circle (midpoint algorithm).

drawRect.desc: Draws the outline of a rectangle with 4 lines.

drawFilledRect.desc: Fills a rectangle (bounds included: width+1 by height+1 pixels).

drawText.desc: Writes text with the internal bitmap font (5 pixels tall). pos.y is the bottom of the line.

drawIcon.desc: Draws a small icon: 'x' (5x5 cross) or 'o' (circle of radius 2). Any other type: nothing.

drawLine.desc: Draws a segment (pixel by pixel along the dominant axis).
